description: This file contains shell script tests for git checkout behavior, specifically testing scenarios involving untracked files, directories, symlinks, and checkout options in a git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the specified path exists and is a regular file.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and stages it for the test.

methods.name: test_path_is_symlink
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is a symlink.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified contents.
